House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Energy Finance and Policy

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to energy; appropriating money for geothermal planning grants.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION. +]

[+Notwithstanding Minnesota Statutes, section 116C.779, subdivision 1, paragraph (j), $....... in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the renewable development account under Minnesota Statutes, section 116C.779, subdivision 1, to the commissioner of commerce to award geothermal planning grants to eligible applicants under Minnesota Statutes, section 216C.47. This is a onetime appropriation. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to energy; appropriating money for geothermal planning grants.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION.

Notwithstanding Minnesota Statutes, section 116C.779, subdivision 1, paragraph (j), $....... in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the renewable development account under Minnesota Statutes, section 116C.779, subdivision 1, to the commissioner of commerce to award geothermal planning grants to eligible applicants under Minnesota Statutes, section 216C.47. This is a onetime appropriation.
additions: Notwithstanding Minnesota Statutes, section 116C.779, subdivision 1, paragraph (j), $....... in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the renewable development account under Minnesota Statutes, section 116C.779, subdivision 1, to the commissioner of commerce to award geothermal planning grants to eligible applicants under Minnesota Statutes, section 216C.47. This is a onetime appropriation.
